stories.title: Man convicted of starting palisades fire
stories.summary: A Los Angeles County jury found former rideshare driver Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty on Friday of starting the 2025 Palisades fire, which caused widespread destruction and loss of life. He faces a prison sentence of between five and 40 years. Liza Kaminov has more.

stories.summary: The boat carrying mourners for a funeral overturned in southern Nigeria. It was the latest in a series of deadly boat accidents in the country.

stories.summary: A fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia's Banten province has killed at least three people. Dozens are also unaccounted for after the blaze, which destroyed large parts of the facility.
